card.name: March of the the Dead
card.text: Creatures you control get afterlife 1. (Whenever that creature dies, create a 1/1 white and black Spirit creature token with flying.)

card.name: Arabel, Seer Prodigy
card.text: When Arabel or another legendary creature enters the battlefield, scry 1.

card.name: Scrying
card.text: Draw 3 cards, then put two cards from your hand on top of your library in any order.

card.name: Blinksy, Toymaker
card.text: {B}, {T}, Pay 1 life: Create a treasure token

card.name: Book of Victims
card.text: {T}: Exile target creature from a graveyard. {5}: Sacrifice Book of Victims. Each opponent loses life equal to the number of cards exiled with Book of Victims.

card.name: Dark Gift
card.text: Enchant creature card in a graveyard When Dark Gift enters the battlefield, if it's on the battlefield, it loses "enchant creature card in a graveyard" and gains "enchant creature put onto the battlefield with Dark Gift." Return enchanted creature card to the battlefield under your control and attach Dark Gift to it. When Dark Gift leaves the battlefield, that creature's controller sacrifices it. Enchanted creature gets +1/+0.

card.name: Drown in the Lake
card.text: Target creature gets -X/-X until the end of turn where X is two plus your devotion to black. (Each {B} in the mana costs of permanents you control counts toward your devotion to black.)

card.name: Revenant
card.text: {1}{B}: Return Revenant from the graveyard to the battlefield tapped.

card.name: Vampire Spawn
card.text: Reach Vampire Spawn enters the battlefield tapped. Whenever a creature dealt damage by Vampire Spawn dies, create a tapped token copy of Vampire Spawn.

card.name: Vladimir & Godfrey, Reunited
card.text: Whenever Vladimir & Godfrey attack or block, create a 2/2 black Zombie Paladin creature token.

card.name: Minnesota, Impulsive Planner
card.text: When you cast your first instant or sorcery each turn roll a d20. [b]1-9[/b]|Target opponent may copy the spell. They may choose new targets for the copy. [b]10-20[/b]|Copy the spell. You may choose new targets for the copy.

card.name: Strahd Von Zarovich
card.text: Nemesis (You may only control one creature or Planeswalker with Nemesis.) Flying Whenever Strahd Von Zarovich deals combat damage to a player that player discards a card and you draw a card. If Strahd Von Zarovich would die, return him to the battlefield tapped and the beginning of the next end step.

card.name: Zas, Barbarian Scholar
card.text: Trample You may exert Zas, Barbarian Scholar as it attacks. When you do, double Zas, Barbarian Scholar's power and toughness until end of turn. (An exerted creature won't untap during your next untap step.)

card.name: Clif, Chilled Tortle
card.text: Lifelink Defender {2}{W}: Clif deals damage to any target equal to the amount of life you gained this turn.

card.name: Harlston, Grappling Pugilist
card.text: Flash When Harlston, Grappling Pugilist enters the battlefield, tap target creature an opponent controls. It doesn't untap during its controllers next untap step.

card.name: Animated Armor
card.text: Flash Vigilance When Animated Armor enters the battlefield, tap target creature.

card.name: Zas's Battleaxe
card.text: Equipped creature gets +2/+0 When equipped creature attacks, roll a d20. Equip {4} [b]1-9[/b]| Equipped creature gains trample until the end of turn. [b]10-19[/b]| Creatures you control gain trample until end of turn. [b]20[/b]| Creatures you control gain trample. Untap each attacking creature you control. After this combat phase, there is an additional combat phase.
